headline: Executive order changes two earlier cybersecurity orders while keeping some of their efforts in place.
what_it_does: This order amends two earlier executive orders on cybersecurity: Executive Order 13694 and Executive Order 14144. Based on its title, it keeps some of the federal government's existing cybersecurity efforts going while changing others. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies that carry out the cybersecurity work set up by the two earlier orders may see their duties changed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 6, 2025; specific effective dates are not stated in the available information.
